description: Live check of the website rules changed after Builderr's audit of version 3, on every website registered in Enhetsregisteret for the 1,000 companies of examples/smoke-1000.txt (drawn at random from Builderr's official company list).
how_it_was_run: agent/website.ts, agent/web.ts and agent/orgnr.ts were downloaded from GitHub at the tested commit, checked by SHA-256 and run in a browser tab on each company's own site (a browser page can read only its own site). Each company's identity came from Enhetsregisteret. The agent's own functions decided: verifyCandidate (is this the company's own site), profilesFrom (social accounts), readSiteActivity (news posts, job ads) and siteContacts. robots.txt was honoured. Seven sites block scripts from other hosts; for those, the homepage and its contact, about and terms pages were searched for the company's organisation number and name instead.
version_3_behaviour: All 107 registered addresses that were not a social profile were published as the company's website (a placeholder page was dropped), including group, manager, chain and brand sites.

fixed_after_this_check: Own sites missed: a title that names the company only as a whole, and a thin homepage of a one-word company on its own name domain.

Profiles: an account named after the company's own verified domain (agropumper.no, innergammelsetra.no, floya.no) is its brand, unless another company on the site has that name (a parent Treteam AS on treteam.no). Small words of the legal name ('for', 'av') are allowed in a handle.
Contacts: only role addresses (post@, salg@, kundeservice@ ...) and the site's main phone number; staff members' own addresses and phones were being published (e.g. first names and initials).
Job ads on recruiting platforms without structured data (Jobylon): the ad counts when its title names this company as the employer and it is not closed. Homely's three Jobylon ads were missed before.
A front page that redirects deeper on the same site (a shop's /password page, a CMS start page) is no longer treated as a page on someone else's site.
A 'News' link back to the front page is not read as the news page.
